checkins_source_ref.name: checkins_source_ref
checkins_source_ref.value:
("checkins"."source" = 'subscription' AND "checkins"."subscription_id" IS NOT NULL AND "checkins"."credit_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("checkins"."source" = 'credit' AND "checkins"."credit_id" IS NOT NULL AND "checkins"."subscription_id" IS NULL)

checkins_confirmed.name: checkins_confirmed
checkins_confirmed.value: "checkins"."status" <> 'confirmed' OR ("checkins"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "checkins"."confirmation_method" IS NOT NULL)

checkins_manual_by.name: checkins_manual_by
checkins_manual_by.value: "checkins"."confirmation_method" IS DISTINCT FROM 'manual' OR "checkins"."confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL

gyms_approved.name: gyms_approved
gyms_approved.value: "gyms"."status" <> 'approved' OR ("gyms"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "gyms"."pagarme_recipient_id" IS NOT NULL)
